feeds.what: every state-level contest of the election in one document (135 ballot items: 4 US House, 15 State Senate, 75 State House, 8 State School Board, 2 constitutional amendments, 31 judicial retention questions), plus 29 county election stubs
feeds.notes: Standard Enhanced Voting shape: …/results/public/api/elections/<slug>/<publicElectionId>/data. slug is 'Utah' with a capital U (that is jurisdiction.shortName and what the site's own redirect uses; I did not test lower case). 24,925 bytes gzipped. Cache-Control: public, max-age=60.

feeds.what: jurisdiction document with the elections list (10 elections back to 2024) and the 29 counties
feeds.notes: Elections list is at api/jurisdictions/<slug> (.elections[]). api/elections/utah and api/elections/Utah both answer 404.

election_id: 'General11032026' (publicElectionId: a hand-typed slug, type + MMDDYYYY). In the page URL /results/public/Utah/elections/General11032026 and the API URL /api/elections/Utah/General11032026/data. Internal GUID election.id = 01000000-3eb9-2098-2ce9-08df22ebab67.
discovery: GET https://electionresults.utah.gov/results/public/api/jurisdictions/Utah and read .elections[] (publicElectionId, electionDate, name). Ids are not predictable: casing varies between elections ('General11032026', 'Primary06232026', but 'general11042025', 'primary08122025', 'general11052024'), so always look the id up by electionDate.
cors: none on 200 responses (no Access-Control-Allow-Origin; 'cross-origin-resource-policy: same-origin'). 404s from the API do carry 'access-control-allow-origin: *'. Needs the relay.
bot_blocking: Relay User-Agent: 200 for the site root, jurisdictions and data (Azure Front Door, X-Cache headers; no challenge). Browser User-Agent not needed, not tried.
updated_field: election.asOf = '2026-11-10T23:06:22.6634728Z' (UTC). Also election.lastUpdated = '2026-11-10T22:59:17.6196599Z', election.publishDate, election.publishVersionId. Repeated per contest in ballotItems[].reportingStatus.asOf.
reporting_field: Per contest: ballotItems[].reportingStatus.reportingUnits / .totalUnits, where the units are COUNTIES (29/29 for a statewide amendment, 3/3 for 'State Senate District 1 (Multi-County)', 1/1 for a single-county district). No precinct progress: election.precinctsReporting null, localityElections[].precinctsReporting null, precinctReportingStatus []. election.totalVoters and ballotsCast are 0.0 (not published).

choice_format: ballotItems[].summaryResults.ballotOptions[]: name [{"languageId":"en","text":"BEN MCADAMS"}] (candidate names are ALL CAPS), voteCount 174492, party {abbreviation: null, name:[{"languageId":"en","text":"Democratic"}]} - Utah fills in only the party's full name ('Republican', 'Democratic', 'Libertarian', 'Constitution', 'Forward', 'Unaffiliated'), never an abbreviation. Constitutional amendments: contestType 'BallotMeasure', options 'FOR' and 'AGAINST'. Judicial retention: also 'BallotMeasure', options 'YES' and 'NO'. isWinner null throughout.
district_field: Only in the title, and multi-county districts carry a ' (Multi-County)' suffix that must be stripped ('State Senate District 1 (Multi-County)'); one has ' (2-Year Term)'. contestGroupId is null for every item (Utah defines no contest groups) and voteFor is an empty array.
terms: none found on the results site or in the API. I did not search vote.utah.gov for a general terms page.
